issue.title: proc.Look keeps "not found" for a tool installed in the same clock tick as its folder's last change
issue.body:
我这台 Linux（ext4，5.15 内核）上跑 `internal/agent`，TestHowInstalled 经常红（`cliupdate_test.go:192: pnpm: <nil>`），在 `c922225f` 上单独跑 5 次红 3 次。TestInstalledVersion、TestOmpDetectedWithPiDir、TestCursorFolderFromTheEditorIsNotTheCLI 也一样，分别是 5/5、5/5、4/5。我之前在 #2932、#2942 的记录里把它们算成了我这台机器 PATH 的问题，其实不是。CI 上是绿的，我不清楚 CI 机器的时钟粒度，可能刚好没撞上。

原因在 `proc.Look`、`FindTool` 和 `listed()` 的缓存：它们靠 PATH 文件夹的修改时间判断有没有变，但这个时间是粗粒度时钟打的。我这台 ext4 上紧跟着建文件，200 次里有 197 次文件夹的时间不动。所以先查一次 pnpm（没有），马上往同一个文件夹写一个 pnpm 再查，第二次拿到的还是缓存里的"没有"。真实使用里就是安装器在同一个 tick 里往 PATH 文件夹写东西，这个工具会一直找不到，直到这个文件夹再变一次，或者点 Look again。

`TestLookPathSeesAnInstallAndARemoval` 里那两个 `time.Sleep(20ms)`（"a folder time a coarse clock tells apart"）其实就是在绕开这个。

补丁在 [`fix/look-racy-stamp`](https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/commits/fix/look-racy-stamp)，一个 commit `f9d7eac9`，基于 `c922225f`，现在的 main `ba319a75` 上也能直接打：

```
git format-patch --stdout c922225f..f9d7eac9 | sha256sum
0c83cfc1d7f057f9b75f08b99e3f0599a2fdabc16847a56d9024707a060c29f4
```

改法：一个文件夹在 100ms 内刚改过，就不信它的时间戳，查到的结果也不留，下次再查。和 git 的 racy entry 是一个思路，magpie 里 `filememo` 的 settled、Codex 列表的 `codexListSettled` 也是这么做的。时间比现在还晚的文件夹算稳定，不然缓存会一直关着。

- 新加的 `TestLookPathSeesAnInstallInTheSameTick` 在旧代码上红，只改 stamp 或只改 listing 也红，两边都改才绿。
- 上面四个 agent 测试不用改，`-count=5` 全绿；TestHowInstalled 改前 10 次红 9 次，改后 0 次。
- `TestLookPathSeesAnInstallAndARemoval` 去掉那两个 sleep 以后，在旧代码上 10 次红 10 次，改后绿。
- `go test -race ./internal/proc/` 绿；完整套件除了我这台机器在干净 main 上本来就红的 8 个，没有新的红。详细记录在 commit body 里。

100ms 而不是 2s：页面一次请求要查一百来个命令，#1624 那次 Windows 加杀毒软件已经慢到 5–8s，窗口越长，刚改过的文件夹被重复读的时间越长。取舍写在 commit body 里了，你觉得 2s 更统一的话改个常量就行。

没试过的：Windows 和 macOS 只跑了 vet，没真机跑；也没拿真实安装器去跟 magpie 抢。

另外两个看到但没动的：TestCodexDriftReached 也经常红（`c922225f` 上 40 次红 20 次），但它读的是 Codex 的 logs_2.sqlite，不是 PATH，跟这个不是一回事。`filememo` 的 settled 会把时间比现在还晚的文件一直当成没稳定、每次都重读，只影响性能。

comments.body:
Implemented on my fork, adapting your `f9d7eac9` patch with `Co-authored-by` retained. Both cache layers now avoid keeping entries for recently changed directories: lookup answers and directory name listings. Stable and future-dated directories still reuse their caches; the normal two-second stat window and explicit Look again refresh remain.

I also froze the clock in `TestLookPathSeesAnInstallInTheSameTick`, so a loaded runner cannot age its directory out of the 100ms window while the test is running. It uses real executable files in an isolated temporary PATH. The regression fails with the original implementation, with only the stamp fixed, and with only the listing fixed; all three failures are the installed executable still being reported missing. Restored, the lookup/listing regressions and the four affected agent tests pass five race runs.

The 100ms tradeoff is kept and documented in code and the subsystem reference: filesystems with timestamp resolution greater than 100ms need a longer settling window. No real installer/account or production configuration was used; Windows/macOS runtime behavior was not tested.

Fork commit: [89bceb39](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/89bceb394593139ed2b708bb1904ee486a508956), branch [fix/path-same-tick-install](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/path-same-tick-install). Go 1.26.8 native/Linux nogui/Windows vet and builds, plus `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m`, all pass at this exact commit (seven checks; 69 packages pass, 19 have no tests). No upstream PR opened.

On b437e4ad it's red 7 of 10 alone (`zed_credential_other_test.go:81: CLI's bundle: ".../Zed Preview.app", <nil>`), and with f9d7eac9 on top it passed 40 of 40. repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:

issue.title: TestCodexDriftReached and TestCodexBehindReverseProxy go red when two log inserts land in one clock tick

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
#3141 里顺手提过 TestCodexDriftReached 经常红，原因找到了，TestCodexBehindReverseProxy 也是同一个。补丁在这：

https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/commits/fix/drift-tests-tick （基于 b437e4ad，一个 commit，只改测试；`git format-patch --stdout b437e4ad..fix/drift-tests-tick | sha256sum` = `05680184e8dd9e7e2ee49f8785704ddfc5c726b29d0372db247b0ec9296c7f22`）

84210ae7（#1665）之后，codexReached 按 logs_2.sqlite 和 -wal 的大小加修改时间缓存读到的结果，最多 15s。这两个测试是插一行日志、马上问 Drift，连着来三四次。两次插入落在同一个时钟 tick 里，大小和时间都不变，Drift 就拿上一次的结果回答。我在这台 Linux（ext4）上量了：回滚日志模式下连着两次插入，400 次里有 317 次 stamp 没变。

b437e4ad 上 `-count=60`：TestCodexDriftReached 红 11 次（`:280 elsewhere` 5 次，`:284 reached magpie` 6 次），TestCodexBehindReverseProxy 红 2 次（`:293 to chatgpt.com: <nil>`）。每次插入后把库文件的修改时间拨回插入前，等于强制落在同一个 tick，两个都是 20/20 红。

改法：这两个测试测的是 Drift 对每种请求怎么说，什么时候重读日志归 TestCodexReachedReadsLogOnlyWhenItChanged 管，所以每次 log 完把缓存清掉（forgetReached）。同样的注入下 20/20 绿，`-count=200` 0 红，手动把拒绝识别和"去了别处"那条分支弄坏，测试照样会红。

全量（`-count=1`）也跑了，这两个是绿的。剩下的红在 b437e4ad 上本来就红（#3141、#3397，加上我这台机器的环境），提交说明里逐个写了。

app 那边没动。Codex 自己的 logs_2.sqlite 是 WAL，我这台上的 -wal 一直停在 4.4MB（已经回绕过了），之后每次写入只改修改时间（WAL 模式下 400 次里有 156 次不变，都是 -wal 回绕之后）。所以 Codex 在 magpie 上次读的同一个 tick 里写下的请求，比如一次连接加紧跟着的 refused，最多会晚 15s 才在 Drift 里出现，这本来就在 reachedFor 的范围内。如果想让 app 也立刻看到，可以像 filememo、codex_list_tag 那样加一个 settle 窗口，代价是 Codex 每次刚写完的那一小段时间里，每次问都要重读一遍，正好是 #1665 省掉的那些读。要不要加你定。

issue.title: agent: Claude Code's first write in a fresh magpie takes a #1985 proxy for a relay (a CLI pick writes 127.0.0.1 over it, Disconnect forgets the user's endpoint)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
#1985 的修法是：Claude Code 被手动指到 magpie 前面的代理上（magpie 的 key 不变）时，要等 magpie 在代理那边应答过，才把它当成还在 magpie 上（surelyMagpie）。这个应答来自读操作在后台发起的探测，不会等。可是每次写 Claude Code 的配置之前都会先读一次 routed()，所以在刚启动的 magpie 进程里（我复现出来的都是 CLI），第一次写的时候探测还没回来，代理就被当成了用户自己的中转。surelyMagpie 的注释写的是写操作会等这个应答，但其实没有地方在等；Codex 的 failover 是等的（codexProxyOK）。

我用一个假代理（relay.py，GET / 按 magpie 网关的格式回 `{"name":"magpie"}`），在全新的 HOME 里用 CLI 跑，让代理 0.3s 或 1.5s 才回（走 VPN 的公司代理差不多这个量级）。40b5c2da 和 #3480 的 d970371e 上结果一样：

- `magpie claude fakeco/fake-3`：ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 从代理 `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/corp-relay` 被改回 magpie 自己的 `127.0.0.1:<port>`，用户单独给 haiku 档设的 fake-2 也变成了 fake-3。像 davisjiahao 那种所有请求都必须过合规代理的情况，这就是悄悄绕过了代理
- `magpie provider add …`（它的 sync 会重写 Claude Code 的列表）：magpie 写的 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 被删掉了
- `magpie claude haiku fakeco/fake-3`：报 `pick a model through magpie for Claude Code first; haiku can then have its own`
- `magpie claude default`（Disconnect）：输出 `disconnected from magpie, back to what it had before`，实际上代理地址、magpie 的 key、magpie 写的四档模型（全是 fake-1）都还在，model 是 opus，而 opus 档还指着 magpie 的 fake-1，等于还在经代理走 magpie；用户接 magpie 之前自己的 endpoint 和 key（`https://own.example/api`、`sk-own-user`）已经从 stash 里删掉，找不回来了

代理马上就回的时候，后台探测基本都能先回来，这些都正常，所以在 GUI 里平时看不出来。`magpie web` 启动我也试了（首次启动 0s 和 1.5s，重启 1.5s），都没问题：它的 sync 要等目录和各家的模型列表拉完才跑，那时探测已经回来了。

补丁：https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/commits/fix/1985-writes-ask-first （一个 commit，cd2c6acd，叠在 #3480 的 d970371e 上，因为改的是 #3480 加的 claudeProxied，需要先打那个；`git format-patch --stdout d970371e..fix/1985-writes-ask-first | sha256sum` = `cab0c3b7250d76f8acbc03de844a1233fdad6849909d59eb902f41e456b4cc1c`）。做法是每次写 Claude Code（每个字段的 Set、Sync、Unwire）之前先 claudeAsk：如果是 claudeProxied 会去问的那种地址（proxyBase，不是网关自己的地址，claudeKeyed），并且这个进程里 magpie 还没在那边应答过，就现在问并等结果（magpieAsked，用 probedNow，探测本身 3s 超时）。已经有应答的话不管多旧都照用，和读操作一样。Follow 没动，它在 routed 之前什么都不写，Agents 页下次绘制会再跑。读操作照旧不等（TestReverseProxyTriedFirst）。

修完同样的脚本，0、0.3、1.5s 下这几种都对了，Disconnect 也把 own.example 和 sk-own-user 放回去了，magpie 的东西一点没留。代价是每个进程第一次写要等一个 GET /。之前的读一般已经在后台问过一次，这里不等那一次而是再问一次（和 codexProxyOK 一样），所以代理会多收到一个 GET /；代理不回的话，这次写最多多等 3s。

有一点这个补丁没处理：Apply 和 Disconnect 在写之前的那次读（was、before）看到的还是没问过的状态。实测冷启动 Disconnect（代理 1.5s）以后，重连用的记录（claude.reconnect）里只有 model，少了在 magpie 里给 haiku 设的 fake-2，同样的操作在 magpie 自己的地址上是会记下来的。要修得在 Agent 上加个钩子，让 Apply 和 Disconnect 先问，改动面会大一些，我就先没动。

测试 TestClaudeFirstWriteAsksTheProxy：nginx 和本机两种代理，各测选模型、Sync、设单档、Disconnect。把 claudeAsk 里的等待去掉，8 个子测试全红，每个都红在它要守的那个结果上；只去掉 Unwire 里的那一处，两个 Disconnect 红。全量（树 57ae956b）63 个包通过，红的 7 个包都是这台机器自己的老问题（#3141 那组、Reasonix 用到的 /tmp/.git、graftcp、umask 077、Bun 1.3.11 的 #3397），详细记录在 commit 里。

Each looks its CLI up on an empty PATH, writes it there, and looks again. On 9fc382e6, alone at -count=10, Copilot is red 7 of 10 (`ide_plugin_dir_test.go:36: the copilot command on PATH no longer finds the Copilot CLI`) and Qoder 9 of 10 (`:86: qodercli on PATH no longer finds Qoder`, and the same for qoderclicn). With the internal/proc change from f9d7eac9, or from skygunner's 89bceb39, both pass 10 of 10.

issue.title: gateway: TestPluginToldWhereTheAgentWorks fails when an empty .git sits above TMPDIR (GitOnDisk takes it as a repository)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
On main c158b043 this test fails on every run here: 5 of 5 with `-count=5`, Bun 1.4.2, Go 1.26.8 on linux/amd64, umask 077, run outside the box's graftcp proxy.

```
--- FAIL: TestPluginToldWhereTheAgentWorks (0.21s)
    plugin_workdir_test.go:110: not in one: the plugin was told "/tmp/TestPluginToldWhereTheAgentWorks4021958867/005", git "yes"; want "/tmp/TestPluginToldWhereTheAgentWorks4021958867/005", "no"
```

Only the "not in one" case fails, and on the git answer rather than the request count, so this isn't #3347 coming back.

It's the same empty /tmp/.git as #3641. GitOnDisk walks up from the folder and counts any .git it finds as a repository, so every t.TempDir() under /tmp comes out "yes". Git doesn't count an empty one: `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` in a folder under it says "not a git repository". Moving TMPDIR shows that's all it is. With TMPDIR=/var/tmp/toldwhere-clean, which has no .git above it, the same run passes 5 of 5. With an empty /var/tmp/toldwhere-git/.git and TMPDIR=/var/tmp/toldwhere-git, it fails 5 of 5 with the same line.

So a machine with a .git anywhere above its temp folder gets this red. One thing for whoever fixes it: the "in a repository" case also makes its repo from an empty .git, so if GitOnDisk starts asking for a real repository, that fixture needs a real one too.

issue.title: Caches keyed by a file's size and time miss a same-size write in the same mtime tick (siblings of #3708)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
My patch for #3708 adds `filememo.Settled`: a stamp of a file's size and time isn't reused until the file's time is 2s old. Linux stamps a file from a clock a few ms coarse, so a second write of the same size inside that tick leaves both as they were, and whatever was read before keeps showing until the next write.

These keep what they read by such a stamp the same way, with no time limit (lines at 1bb8143b).

internal/sessions:
- `ocStamp` (calls_opencode.go:67): OpenCode's and ZCode's call lists, and WorkBuddy's models.json (`buddyGatewayIDs`)
- `hermesRevision` (hermes.go:91)
- `pollOpenCode`'s stamp (traces_opencode.go:74)
- Cline's carry (cline.go:148)
- `cursorStamp` (cursor_snapshot.go:44). A new copy for each look while the store's time is that recent would bring #1988 back, so this one needs another way.
- the parse `refresh` keeps for each session file (sessions.go:914), for an agent that rewrites its session file whole. A file that is only appended to can't keep its size.

Elsewhere:
- proc/look.go:134 is #3141.
- proc/version.go:38: a CLI whose `--version` failed isn't run again.
- the plugin loaders' stamps, agentplug/agentplug.go:200 and middleware/middleware.go:150, and plugin/store.go:287's `listStamp` under both.
- omarchy/omarchy.go:367, the theme.
- usage's `statKey` (request_page.go:600), in the request page's and the summary's keys. #1305 gave the usage log's own stamp a settle rule; these have none.

Two keep theirs for a while only, so a missed write shows up later: agent/cliupdate.go:584 (a CLI's version, up to a day) and provider/vertex.go:298 (a Vertex token, until it nearly lapses). Two already allow for it: agent's reads of Codex's log and AionUi's database (`stampOf`, codex.go:2130) stand 15s at most (`reachedFor`), and library's tree memo keeps nothing whose newest file is under 3s old (`settleFor`).

Each needs its own look at what a read costs while the time is recent. I'll take the internal/sessions ones once #3708 is in.

issue.title: A silent request to `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, every 30 s, that can't be turned off

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
First, thanks for building magpie — I only started using it recently and it's been working well. One thing I ran into:

magpie keeps sending this, about every 30 s, to whatever `env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` in `~/.claude/settings.json` points at:

```
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: <that URL's host>
User-Agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Accept-Encoding: gzip
```

I never connected Claude Code to magpie, and it never wrote that file.

- Code: `internal/agent/reach.go:52` `realMagpieProbe()`; the address comes from `reach.go:87` `proxyBase()`, read from `env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` (`internal/agent/claude.go:603`) — any remote address is probed, managed or not.
- What triggers it is a read, not a write: `internal/gui/api.go:911` `/api/drift` → `internal/agent/applied.go:173` `Values()` → `claude.go:734` `get()` → `claude.go:616` `routed()` → `reach.go:129` `surelyMagpie()`.
- No setting turns it off; hiding the agent only changes the display (`internal/settings/settings.go:569`). It is silent as well — the UI shows nothing (`claude.go:2146`).

My concern: an outbound request I never authorized, that I can't see and can't stop. Please add a switch, or don't probe agents magpie doesn't manage.

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Seen while mote (the macOS test box) was unreachable, so a change's suite ran on the Linux box instead (`wsl-run`, WSL2 distro magpie-desktop, Go 1.26.8). Each of these is red at origin/main eb6d1d8d9 run alone on that box too (`go test -tags nogui -count=1 -run …`), so they are the box or Linux under WSL, not a change. None is about the change that ran.

internal/agent (a fake binary the test writes under /tmp doesn't run, or isn't found):
- TestInstalledVersion: `cliupdate_test.go:60: "0.98.2": ""`
- TestHowInstalled: `cliupdate_test.go:192: pnpm: <nil>` (passed alone once)
- TestGrokInstalled: `grok --version fails: /tmp/TestGrokInstalled…/.grok/bin/grok: Invalid argument`

- TestCopilotFolderFromAnIDEPluginIsNotTheCLI: `the copilot command on PATH no longer finds the Copilot CLI` (passed alone once)
- TestOmpDetectedWithPiDir: `omp's command is not`
- TestZedAppPath: `CLI's bundle: "/tmp/TestZedAppPath…/Applications/Zed Preview.app", <nil>`

internal/proc:
- TestTreeRSS: `rss_test.go:32: a running sleep holds 0 bytes (false)`

(internal/gateway's TestUploadStillUnderwayIsNotCutByHealthPing is red there too, 3 of 3 at main; that one is #3909.)

"Invalid argument" on exec suggests the distro's /tmp can't run what a test writes there (#3141's same-tick proc.Look may be the rest). If the box is meant to run the whole suite, these need a cause; if not, wsl-run's doc should say which packages it can't.
